statement: For the actual symplectic-isomorphism neighbourhood attached to an odd integral Legendre level of a rational-tripod section, full GL2(Z/N) torsion image implies exactly three rational cusp orbits and rational unit rank2. Every unit has a positive power equal to a rational constant times lambda^a(1-lambda)^b, so a unit regular and nonzero over two different original labels is constant. The point section lambda3 has full GL2(Z5) image and gives an explicit infinite such tower. A finite-index cyclotomic-kernel image also gives a uniform unit-rank bound in its prime-power tower.
where_proved: sections/D_modular_unit_obstruction.tex, D.32 and the following Manin-Drinfeld and bounded-index paragraphs; full audit in audit/D_modular_level_unit_rank_obstruction.md
depends_on: Explicit Legendre Picard-Lefschetz matrices; Galois-equivariant Tate uniformization and Weil-pairing determinant; elementary matrix generation; exact E3(F7) count; Drinfeld1973 Theorem1 only for the separate congruence-curve rank explanation; D.31 solely as the route being audited

notes: Root reviewed the complete audit and authorized integration; topos independently checked the cusp-action convention, quadratic twist, E3 trace and full5-adic image proof. Exact finite certificate code/D_modular_cusp_orbits.py/.json passes. Full versus projective inertia is retained: orders N,N,2N in the full cover. The integral level module is the section's actual pullback, not an unproved integral refinement of D.30's rational comparison. The infinite explicit example is a point section and disproves only automatic unit-rank growth in this class of neighbourhoods. No nongeometric section, mixed-label section, or failure of every noncongruence neighbourhood is asserted. Finite ramification and the universal mixed-label case remain unresolved.
